initial_inquiry.text: Hi, I'm looking for a 6-bedroom waterfront home in Coral Gables under $400,000. My timeline is within 60 days. Cash buyer.

So my husband and I have been thinking about relocating for a while now, it's been quite the journey honestly. We live in Chicago currently but with the winters getting harder and our youngest heading off to college soon we thought maybe Florida would be a nice change of pace. My sister lives near Miami and she loves it there — we've been visiting on and off for years. We're not entirely sure about the timeline yet, could be next year or the year after, and we haven't fully decided if we want a condo or a house. Budget is somewhere between 600K and maybe 900K if we really love it. We'd want at least 3 bedrooms because grandkids will visit. Waterfront would be dream but we know that's expensive. We're also considering Naples and Sarasota so this isn't a done deal for Coral Gables but we're just exploring our options. Anyway would love your thoughts on where we should start. My sister mentioned your name so figured I'd reach out. Thanks!
